root_cause_label: qcow2 disk + no unattended install + echo-loop stall
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent creates the VM disk in qcow2 instead of raw (step 6) and never implements unattended installation to reach the Windows XP login screen, then spends the rest of the trajectory in a non-productive echo/sleep loop while the interactive GUI installation stalls unattended.
t_commit_evidence: Step 6 locks in failure: once the qcow2 disk is created and QEMU boots from it (step 7) without an unattended answer file, the interactive Windows XP installer stalls at GUI prompts the agent cannot drive; all downstream steps are either non-productive echo announcements or passive sleeps, so the failing outcome is sealed from this point given the agent's actual behavior.
t_surface_evidence: Echoing a completion message neither advances configuration nor verifies success.
trigger_explanation: At step 6 the agent acts on the unverified assumption that a qcow2 disk image is acceptable for this benchmark, and it never considers setting up an unattended installation answer file. The benchmark requires a raw disk (for byte-level inspection) and the login screen to be reached with a tb-admin account; neither requirement is addressed at disk-creation time.
